locations.title: Locations
locations.description: List of cities, neighborhoods, or ZIP codes to search. Examples: 'Mead, CO', 'Boulder, CO', '80542'

profileUrls.title: Profile URLs (optional)
profileUrls.description: Optional: scrape specific Zillow agent profile URLs directly (fully enriched), in addition to or instead of location searches. Example: 'https://www.zillow.com/profile/RealEstateStore251'

maxPages.title: Max Pages Per Location
maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to scrape per location. Zillow caps at 25.

enrichProfiles.title: Enrich with Profile Data
enrichProfiles.description: Visit each agent's profile page to get additional data (phone, email, social media, license). Much slower but gets more fields.

maxProfilesPerLocation.title: Max Profiles to Enrich
maxProfilesPerLocation.description: Maximum number of profiles to visit per location (only used when Enrich is ON). Set to 0 for unlimited.

proxy.title: Proxy Configuration
proxy.description: Proxy settings. Residential proxies strongly recommended for Zillow.

delayBetweenPages.title: Delay Between Pages (seconds)
delayBetweenPages.description: Random delay between page loads to avoid detection
